scoring_justification: We recompute reaction barriers and sign of free-energy changes from the agent's raw Gibbs free energy profiles; adsorption energy/Bader charge ordering and tolerance checks against paper-reported values.

outputs.description: Computed CO₂ adsorption energies and Bader charges on pristine, V_BrS, and V surfaces. Checked for correct relative ordering (more negative E_ads, larger charge on V) and values within tolerance using reference match.

Gibbs free energy of each elementary step for CO₂ reduction to CH₃OH on the three surfaces. Checked for correct barrier orderings and exothermic *CO→*CHO step on V surface, using recomputed metric scoring.

output_contract.notes: All values are computed by periodic DFT with an open-source planewave/pseudopotential code. The checker compares against hidden reference values using reference_match for step_02 and metric_recompute for step_03.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference adsorption energies, Bader charges, barrier targets, and reaction step names for DFT surface calculations
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper JACS 2021, 143, 6551-6559: E_ads values reported on page 6556 (pristine -2.63 eV, V -2.73 eV); Bader charges from Bader analysis (0.46 e pristine, 1.22 e V); free-energy barrier for *COOH->*CO on V (0.82 eV) and pristine (1.80 eV) from Figs. 4c,e; *CO->*CHO exothermic on V and endothermic on pristine as stated in text and Fig. 4e.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and figures; inline in grading_spec.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values directly from the published paper; serve as authoritative gold for DFT reproduction.
